title: Dynamic differential privacy to federated learning systems
assignee: Hong Kong Applied Science and Technology Research Institute ASTRI

pse.problem: Data privacy concerns in federated machine learning due to the need to comply with various data privacy regulations.
pse.solution_function: Dynamic differential privacy is applied to input data and ML modeling data in a federated learning process, allowing data sharing while balancing data transparency and privacy protection. This is achieved through noise introduction, anonymization, and encryption, and by dynamically applying hierarchies of loss requirements to different stages and forms of data.
pse.solution_structure: The solution involves multiple data owners, each with their own machine learning models generated and trained on their respective data sets. A system for dynamic differential privacy includes components for noise introduction, anonymization, encryption, and hierarchies of loss requirements.
pse.solution_implementation: Data is processed through the system in a distributed environment. Noise is introduced to input data and ML modeling data to ensure privacy. Anonymization and encryption techniques are applied to further protect sensitive information. Differently tiered privacy loss requirements are dynamically applied during the federated learning process.
pse.effect: The solution enables data sharing among different stakeholders in a federated learning scenario while ensuring compliance with various data privacy regulations, potentially leading to more comprehensive analyses and improved ML model accuracy
